sentences.text: Smt. Shalu vs Rameshchandra Regar ... on 10 October, 2024
Author: Manoj Kumar Garg
Bench: Manoj Kumar Garg [2024:RJ-JD:41603]

HIGH COURT OF JUDICATURE FOR RAJASTHAN AT  JODHPUR  S.B. Civil Transfer Appl. No. 16/2024 Smt. Shalu D/o Sh. Bheemraj Nawal, Aged About 27 Years, B/c Regar, R/o Nawlo Ka Waas, Satlana, Ps Luni, Tehsil Luni, Dist.
Jodhpur (Raj.)
 ----Petitioner  Versus Rameshchandra Regar S/o Sh. Hajarilal Regar, Aged About 37 Years, R/o Village Itunda, Tehsil Jahajpur, Dist. Bhilwara , Raj.

entities.text: HIGH COURT OF JUDICATURE FOR RAJASTHAN AT  JODHPUR
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: ----Respondent For Petitioner(s) : Ms. Kshama Purohit For Respondent(s) : Ms. Nikita Sankhla  Ms. Urmila Sankhla  HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE MANOJ KUMAR GARG Order 10/10/2024

The present transfer petition has been filed by the petitioner with the prayer that the Misc. Case No. 13/2023 pending before the Family Court, Shahpura, District Bhilwara be transferred to the Family court, Jodhpur.
Counsel for the petitioner argued that the respondent has filed a petition against the petitioner under Section 13 of the Hindu Marriage Act before the Family Court, Shahpura, District Bhilwara.
It is submitted that the petitioner is living at Jodhpur and the respondent has filed the said case only with a view to harass the petitioner.
It is submitted that after few years of marriage, the petitioner was ousted from her matrimonial home and continuously harassed for extraneous reasons.

The petitioner has resorted to legal proceedings at Jodhpur and has filed [2024:RJ-JD:41603] (2 of 3)
[CTA-16/2024] petitioner under Section 9 of Hindu Marriage Act so also criminal case under Section 498A, 323, 354, 406 IPC at Jodhpur .

It is submitted that being a lady living with old aged parents, it is very difficult for her to travel to Bhilwara from her residential place at Jodhpur,
therefore, the Case No. 13/2023 may be transferred to Family court No.1, Jodhpur metropolitan.
Per contra, counsel for the respondent opposed the prayer made by the petitioner and submits that the petitioner has left the matrimonial home without any reason on her own.

It is argued that no Smt. Shalu vs Rameshchandra Regar ... on 10 October, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/18994926/
1 case is made out for transfer of the case from Bhilwara to Jodhpur and the petition is liable to be rejected.
I have heard counsel for the parties and perused the documents on record.
The respondent has filed an application under Section 13 of Hindu Marriage Act against the petitioner before the Family Court, Shahpura, District Bhilwara but the petitioner is residing at Jodhpur.

Hon'ble Supreme Court in the case of Vinisha Jitesh Tolani @ Manmeet Laghmani Vs.
Jitesh Kishore Tolani reported in 2010 (1) WLC (SC) 705 has observed that in the matrimonial proceeding instituted by the husband against the wife, the convenience of the wife has to be considered in contesting the suit and accordingly, the matrimonial proceedings ought to be transferred where the wife was residing.

sentences.text:
Recently, the co-ordinate Bench of this Court in the case [2024:RJ-JD:41603] (3 of 3) [CTA-16/2024] of Ekta Dhadhich vs.
Rajendra Prasad Sharma (S.B. Civil Transfer application NO. 72/2021) decided on 30.09.2021 directed the case to be transferred from Ajmer to Family Court at Kota.

sentences.text: Looking to the facts and circumstances of the case and the reasons mentioned in the transfer petition, this petition is allowed.

It is ordered that the Misc. Case No. 13/2023 pending before Family Court, Shahpura, District Bhilwara titled as 'Ramesh Chandra Regar Vs. Smt. Shalu' be transferred to the court of Family court No.1, Jodhpur metropolitan.

Stay application also stands disposed of.
